title: Fail-closed pre-push review with a round budget
summary: The pre-push review stops being advisory. `--warn-only` is removed, so `osf review run` now exits non-zero on a kept must-fix or should-fix finding and on a review that could not run, and a new round budget in the journal state lets a push through after a configured number of failed rounds. A credential preflight decides a missing key or login before any reviewer process starts, osf's own `.osf/` output is filtered out of the changed-file set so a review round cannot change the next round's lens selection, and opencode's provider key is renamed from `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` to `OPENCODE_API_KEY` across the agent roster, the reusable workflow and the docs.

nodes.label: moon `review` task

nodes.label: review run / review reduce
nodes.subtitle: review_run_cmd, review_reduce_cmd
nodes.summary: The `--warn-only` flag is gone from both argument structs, and the command returns the exit code directly instead of forcing zero.

nodes.label: finish_review
nodes.subtitle: verdict + kept findings → exit code
nodes.summary: Computes a blocking flag from kept must-fix and should-fix findings, then either returns the base code (reduce) or consults the round budget (run).

nodes.label: round_allows_push
nodes.subtitle: RoundKind → bool
nodes.summary: Applies the pre-push budget: a pass clears the counts, a findings round increments and allows past the limit, a could-not-run round increments and errors past its own limit.

nodes.label: RoundCounts
nodes.subtitle: review-rounds/<hash>.json
nodes.summary: Per-worktree counters for failed findings rounds and could-not-run rounds, keyed by a hash of the canonical worktree path and stored under the journal state dir.

nodes.label: ReviewConfig
nodes.subtitle: in_sandbox_rounds, could_not_run_rounds
nodes.summary: Two new round limits default to three each and are rejected when zero; the whole-run timeout default drops from 2700 to 1800 seconds.

nodes.label: osf.toml [review]
nodes.subtitle: concurrency 16, timeout 1800
nodes.summary: Pins the review concurrency and whole-run timeout for this repository, and renames the opencode credential in the roster comment.

nodes.label: setup
nodes.subtitle: lens selection
nodes.summary: Filters `.osf` paths out of the changed-file set before lens selection, so a review round's own output cannot change which lenses the next round picks.

nodes.label: changeset_risk::changed_files
nodes.subtitle: untracked filter
nodes.summary: Drops untracked paths under `.osf/` from the risk assessment's file set, for the same reason.

nodes.label: missing_credentials
nodes.subtitle: Reviewer::missing_credentials
nodes.summary: Decides whether a reviewer has any way to sign in: a non-empty credential variable, or one existing login path under the real home. Templated reviewers and the test escape hatch are exempt.

nodes.label: preflight_and_not_run
nodes.subtitle: no worker starts
nodes.summary: Runs the credential preflight before any reviewer process, and records every lens as could-not-run with the same reason when it fails.

nodes.label: AGENTS roster
nodes.subtitle: opencode credential_env
nodes.summary: opencode's credential variable becomes `OPENCODE_API_KEY`; it keeps its own auth file as a login path.

nodes.label: secret_values::held
nodes.subtitle: login-file leaves
nodes.summary: Adds every string leaf of each agent's JSON login file to the set of values scrubbed from reviewer output.

nodes.label: review-check.yml
nodes.subtitle: reusable workflow
nodes.summary: The opencode job's secret input is renamed to `OSF_REVIEW_OPENCODE_API_KEY` and passed into the container as `OPENCODE_API_KEY`.

nodes.label: opencode provider

nodes.summary: The model provider the opencode reviewer calls, authenticated by the renamed key.

edges.label: no --warn-only
edges.summary: The pre-push task now invokes the review without the flag that used to force a zero exit.
The command hands the outcome to the shared exit-code decision with round counting on.
A blocking finding or a could-not-run verdict is now weighed against the round budget before the exit code is chosen.

edges.label: round limits
edges.summary: The limits come from `[review]` in the trusted config root.

edges.label: increment / clear
edges.summary: Each failed round increments its counter; a pass removes the file.
Setup now asks the credential preflight before deciding a reviewer's fate.
The preflight result becomes a could-not-run record for every selected lens.

edges.label: changed files
edges.summary: Both paths now drop osf's own `.osf/` output from the change they judge.

edges.label: credential_env, login_paths
edges.summary: The roster supplies the variables and login paths the preflight checks.

edges.label: login_paths
edges.summary: The scrubber reads each agent's login file through the roster's paths.

edges.label: OPENCODE_API_KEY
edges.summary: The opencode job reaches its provider with the renamed key in the environment.
The repository's `[review]` section supplies concurrency and the whole-run timeout.
